about.intro: Mavero began with a simple frustration: it had become genuinely difficult to buy something well made. Fast fashion crowded out craftsmanship, and the pieces that were built to last were scattered across a dozen boutiques, each with its own story to chase down. We started Mavero to bring that search to one place — a single, considered collection of apparel, footwear, leather goods, and fine accessories, chosen because they hold up, not because they trend.

lookFor.heading: What we look for
lookFor.body: Every piece in the Mavero collection is selected against the same short list: materials that age well rather than wear out, construction that could be repaired rather than replaced, and design that doesn't chase a season. That's why you'll find full-grain leather instead of bonded, Goodyear welts instead of glued soles, and two-ply cashmere instead of a single thin layer. It costs more to make things this way. We think it costs less over the years you'll actually own them.

howWeWork.heading: How we work
howWeWork.body: We're a small, independent team. We photograph and describe every product ourselves, we answer our own customer emails, and we read every review that comes in — good or not. If something isn't right with an order, we'd rather hear about it directly and fix it than have you write it off quietly. You can reach us anytime through our Contact page.

whereHeaded.heading: Where we're headed
whereHeaded.body: Mavero is still young, and the collection grows slowly and deliberately — we'd rather add ten pieces we believe in each season than a hundred we don't. Thank you for being part of that from early on.

items.a: Standard shipping typically arrives within 5–8 business days. Expedited options are shown at checkout. See our Shipping Policy for full details on carriers and international timelines.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
items.a: If your order hasn't shipped yet, contact us right away through the Contact page and we'll do our best to adjust it. Once an order ships, it can no longer be changed or cancelled.
Yes — international shipping is calculated at checkout based on your address. Customs fees and import duties, if any, are the responsibility of the recipient.
Unworn items in original condition can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. See our Return & Refund Policy for the complete process.

items.q: How long do refunds take to process?
items.a: Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 5–7 business days back to your original payment method.

items.q: How do I know what size to order?
items.a: Each product page lists available sizes and disables anything currently out of stock. If you're between sizes, our Contact page is the fastest way to ask for guidance on a specific piece.
Yes — every product photo is of the actual item we ship, not a stock image. Colors can vary slightly by monitor, but we don't use styled photography that misrepresents the product.

items.q: Do I need an account to check out?
items.a: Yes — creating a free account lets us keep your order history, saved addresses, and wishlist in one place, and it's what lets you track an order after it ships.

items.q: Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
items.a: Cash on Delivery is offered as a payment option at checkout alongside card payment; availability can depend on your delivery address.

privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Mavero collects when you use our site, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices you have.

collect.heading: Information we collect
collect.accountInfo: Account information: name, email address, and (optionally) phone number and saved addresses, when you create an account.
collect.orderInfo: Order information: shipping address, items purchased, and order history. We do not process or store real payment card numbers — checkout on this site uses a simulated payment flow for demonstration purposes.
collect.contentSubmitted: Content you submit: product reviews, contact form messages, and newsletter sign-ups.
collect.usageInfo: Usage information: basic device/browser information and locally-stored preferences (theme, language, cart, recently viewed items) via cookies and browser storage.

howWeUse.heading: How we use your information
howWeUse.body: We use your information to create and manage your account, process and fulfil orders, respond to support requests, and — only if you opt in — send newsletter emails. We do not sell your personal information.

thirdParty.heading: Third-party services we use
thirdParty.intro: Mavero is built on a small number of trusted third-party services that process data on our behalf:
thirdParty.firebase: Firebase (Google): handles account authentication and stores account, order, review, and catalog data in Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore.
thirdParty.cloudinary: Cloudinary: hosts product and category images.
thirdParty.closing: Each of these providers has its own privacy practices governing the infrastructure they operate; we only share the minimum data needed for them to perform their function for us.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can review and update most of your account information at any time from your Account page. You may request a copy of your data, request that we delete your account and associated data, or ask us any question about how your information is handled, by reaching out through our Contact page.

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.body: We retain account and order information for as long as your account is active, or as needed to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the date at the top of this page.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Mavero website and any purchases made through it. By creating an account or placing an order, you agree to these terms.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: You're responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity that happens under your account. Let us know right away through our Contact page if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.

ordersPricing.heading: Orders & pricing
ordersPricing.body: All prices are listed in USD and are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to limit quantities, refuse an order, or cancel an order in the case of a pricing or stock error, in which case we'll notify you and issue a full refund for any amount charged.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: This site offers a simulated card-payment flow for demonstration purposes alongside a Cash on Delivery option — no real card transaction is processed through this website. Card details entered at checkout are validated for format only and are not stored or transmitted to a payment processor.

productDescriptions.heading: Product descriptions
productDescriptions.body: We do our best to ensure product descriptions, images, and availability are accurate. Occasionally an item may be listed in error or go out of stock between the time you view it and the time you order — if that happens, we'll reach out before fulfilling the affected part of your order.

intellectualProperty.heading: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: All content on this site — including product photography, copy, and the Mavero name and logo — belongs to Mavero and may not be reproduced without permission.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: Mavero is provided on an "as is" basis. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the site.

governingLaw.heading: Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Mavero operates, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

relatedPolicies.heading: Related policies
relatedPolicies.body: Please also review our related policies below, which are incorporated into these terms by reference.

processingTime.heading: Processing time
processingTime.body: Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days of being placed. You'll receive an update as your order moves through processing, shipping, and delivery — you can check its status anytime from My Orders.

shippingTimes.heading: Shipping times
shippingTimes.international: International shipping: 7–14 business days, depending on destination
shippingTimes.note: These are estimates, not guarantees — carrier delays, customs processing, and remote destinations can extend delivery times beyond the ranges above.

shippingCosts.heading: Shipping costs
shippingCosts.body: Shipping cost is calculated at checkout based on your delivery address and the shipping method you choose, before you confirm your order.

internationalOrders.heading: International orders
internationalOrders.body: International customers are responsible for any customs duties, import taxes, or fees charged by their destination country. These are not included in the order total shown at checkout.

orderTracking.heading: Order tracking
orderTracking.body: As your order status updates, you'll be able to follow its progress through a simple status tracker on the order detail page — from pending, to processing, to shipped, to delivered.

questions.heading: Questions about your shipment
questions.body: If your order hasn't arrived within the expected window, contact us with your order number and we'll look into it.

thirtyDay.heading: 30-day returns
thirtyDay.body: We want you to be genuinely happy with what you order. If something isn't right, you can return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the item is unworn, unwashed, and in its original condition with tags attached.

howToStart.heading: How to start a return
howToStart.step1: Find the order in My Orders and note the order number.
howToStart.step2: Reach out through our Contact page with your order number and the item(s) you'd like to return.
howToStart.step3: We'll confirm the return and provide instructions for sending the item back.

refunds.heading: Refunds
refunds.body: Once we receive and inspect your return, we'll process your refund to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. You'll receive a confirmation once it's issued.

exchanges.heading: Exchanges
exchanges.body: If you need a different size or color, the fastest option is to return the original item for a refund and place a new order for the piece you'd prefer — this avoids the wait for a back-and-forth exchange shipment.

nonReturnable.heading: Non-returnable items
nonReturnable.body: For hygiene reasons, earrings and other pierced jewelry cannot be returned once the packaging seal has been broken, unless the item arrived defective.

damaged.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
damaged.body: If an item arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, let us know within 7 days of delivery with a photo, and we'll arrange a replacement or refund at no cost to you.

whatCovers.heading: What this covers
whatCovers.body: Mavero uses browser storage (cookies and, more often, localStorage) to keep the site working smoothly across visits. This page explains what we store and why.

whatWeStore.heading: What we store
whatWeStore.session: Sign-in session: Firebase Authentication keeps you signed in between visits.
whatWeStore.theme: Theme preference: your light/dark mode choice.
whatWeStore.language: Language preference: your selected site language.
whatWeStore.guestCart: Guest cart: items in your cart before you sign in, so nothing is lost.
whatWeStore.recentlyViewed: Recently viewed products: a short list of products you've looked at, shown on product pages.
whatWeStore.consent: Cookie consent: whether you've dismissed the cookie banner.

whatWeDont.heading: What we don't do
whatWeDont.body: We don't use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. Everything listed above exists to make the site function the way you'd expect, not to track you across other websites.

managing.heading: Managing storage
managing.body: Most of this information is stored client-side in your browser. You can clear it at any time through your browser's settings — note that doing so will sign you out, reset your theme/language preferences, and clear your guest cart.
